In Singapore, roads near schools are often painted red to alert drivers to slow down and watch for children. As a responsible citizen, you want your robot car to recognize school zones and adjust its speed automatically.


Write a program to simulate the control as follows:
  • Travel at speed 40 in a normal zone and speed 10 in a school zone.
  • Steer left: Button D22
  • Steer right: Button D24
  • Moves forward: Buttons D22+D24

  • Steer left: Button D22
